maintenance_led.reason: Sells new broadband access equipment (vCMTS, OLTs, DAA nodes) and video software/SaaS to operators, mainly new deployments and upgrades.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private cable, telco and media operators paid by subscribers and advertisers; BEAD funding is only a minor channel.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own broadband and video product development and sales, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Its cOS broadband platform and video processing systems run operators' core networks; switching needs re-qualification, integration and risks downtime.

notes: Harmonic has broadband and video segments; the website text shown emphasises broadband, and I judged using both.
